5. Her supplication on the night of her death seeking divine mercy
introduction:
Her supplication on the night of her death seeking divine mercy

It is narrated from Ameerul Momineen (a.s.) that the night the Almighty Allah summoned Fatima to His court, she looked at me and said: And peace be on you; and she said: O cousin, Jibraeel came to me with greetings of the Lord till he said:

She was heard saying:

Then she was heard saying:

Then she closed her eyes and spread her limbs as if there was no life in her at all.

verses.arabic: وَ عَلَيْكَ السَّلَامُ يَا قَابِضَ الْاَرْوَاحِ، عَجِّلْ بِيْ، وَ لَا تُعَذِّبْنِيْ
